sources.title: MDPS Warning Lamp Diagnostic Inspection & Single Parts Replacement
sources.scope: USA; Optima JF/JFa 2016–2017 MY, Optima HEV/PHEV JF 2017 MY, Sorento UMa 2016–2017 MY; production date/VIN limits
sources.limitations: DTC numbers and conditional actions only; bulletin lacks individual DTC definitions, wiring pinouts, engine identification.

sources.title: IVT Oil Pressure Sensor Replacement
sources.scope: USA Rio SC 2018–2023 MY, Forte BDm 2019–2024 MY, Soul SK3 2020–2024 MY, Seltos SP2 2021–2024 MY, IVT-equipped only
sources.limitations: Applies only if no drivability issue and no concurrent P0730XX/P0731XX/P0741XX; XX denotes variable suffix and is not a literal DTC.

sources.title: ACU Operation Logic Improvement SA609
sources.scope: USA 2025MY K5 DL3, produced 2024-02-20 through 2024-10-25, affected VIN/ACU ROM only
sources.limitations: Addresses ACU software judgement; DTC reporting module and wiring pinouts not independently confirmed.
